title: Coefficient/exponent pair (2, 1) for MOD3 via self-contained gate elimination

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Language L={x in {0,1}*: |x|_1 = 0 mod 3}, decided by a fixed linear-time counter; NP verifier V(x,w)=1 iff w is empty and x in L, witness bound W(n)=0.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"2"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"2"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one total uniform linear-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(f_n)>=2n-3 for every integer n>=2 in the full Li\u2013Yang B2 model at actual input length n=|x|; hence liminf C_B2(f_n)/n>=2.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
